# Skips the superbuild lanes accept from the hipDNN tooling pytest suites.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/check_pytest_junit.py in .github/workflows/hipdnn-superbuild-ci.yml.
# The Windows lane also reads hipdnn-tooling-allowed-skips-windows.txt for the skips only it makes.
# Each line is `<pattern> # <reason>`; every entry needs a reason. The pattern is an fnmatch
# glob over `<junit file stem>::<classname>::<test name>`, e.g.
# `hipdnn_ingestor_generator_pytest::tests.test_round_trip::test_x[param]`. The junit stem is
# the ctest test name. An entry that matches no skipped test fails the check, so delete entries
# whose skip is gone.
#
# Add an entry only for an input the author supplies by design. A skip whose input the build
# can provide is a gate to close, not an entry to add.
hipdnn_ingestor_generator_pytest::tests.test_coverage_gate.TestAgainstTheRealBuild::* # needs an authoring profile matching the packed build; the repo ships none by design (test_coverage_gate.py _NEEDS_BUILD_REASON)
hipdnn_ingestor_generator_pytest::tests.test_variant_reachability.TestGfx950RealBundle::* # needs a mined request corpus via HIPDNN_INGESTOR_SHAPES; the repo ships none by design
